findings.problem: Still not fixed. The preview says "Last chance to join before the doors close." This is fake urgency. "Last chance" is on the banned list, and nothing says the doors are closing.
findings.fix: Use a friendly, honest preview, for example "Your first monthly box of loose-leaf tea is ready when you are."

findings.problem: Still not fixed. "This is your last chance" is banned fake urgency. "At the launch price" suggests a deal, but the email never gives a real price, which goes against the price and savings rule.
findings.fix: Remove the urgency. Give the real price and what's in the box, for example "Your box is $X a month and holds three loose-leaf teas." Only mention a launch price if one really exists, and then say what it is.

findings.problem: Still not fixed. There is a second link in the body ("Read about our teas"). The email rules allow only one main link.
findings.fix: Delete this line, or fold the idea into the text around the single "Start your box" button.

findings.problem: Still not fixed. The email asks people to join but never says when they pay, when the box renews, or how to skip or cancel. The voice guide says launch emails must say this.
findings.fix: Add a line near the button, for example: "You pay for your 5 January box on the day you join, and your next payment is on 1 February. Your box renews on the 1st of each month, and you can skip or cancel in one click from your account anytime before then."
